svg.title: Option A: Non-Destructive 16-Pin Sumitomo Adapter Wiring (LilyGo T-2CAN, IT-CAN + Optional AV-CAN)
svg.text: Option A (Recommended): Non-Destructive 16-Pin Adapter — LilyGo T-2CAN (IT-CAN + Optional AV-CAN)
All connector pinouts shown from WIRE-SIDE VIEW (looking into wire-entry back of connector, lock tab on top — matches tcu_pins.jpg). Dashed lines = optional AV-CAN.
2. CAR SIDE (Behind Glovebox — No Factory Wires Cut)
transceivers; usually works without them too).
Wire-Side View (6 std + 2 opt. AV pins)
GND splice (4 ends, or 5 w/ SGNDA)
• +12V (Red, 3 ends): Male Pin 1 + loop to Male Pin 9 + via 2A Fuse to 12V->USB (+)
• GND (Black, 4 or 5 ends): Male Pin 2 + loop to Pin 10 + 12V->USB (-) + SGNDB (+ opt. SGNDA)
• IT-CAN (Required): Male Pin 3 -> Port B CANHB | Male Pin 4 -> Port B CANLB
• AV-CAN / M-CAN (Optional): Male Pin 5 -> Port A CANHA | Male Pin 6 -> Port A CANLA
(Enables automatic infotainment nag-screen dismissal & GPS location tracking)
• Why loop Pins 1->9 & 2->10? Routes +12V & GND back to the factory TCU so the cabin
hands-free microphone keeps working, without cutting any factory wires!
• Passive-monitoring option: See wiring_can_loopback.svg to loop CAN back via Pins 11–14.
• OEM #6 (SB, Sky Blue): IT-CAN H -> Fem Pin 3
• OEM #7 (V, Violet): IT-CAN L -> Fem Pin 4
• OEM #26 (SB, Sky Blue): M CAN-H -> Fem Pin 5
• OEM #27 (LG, Lt Green): M CAN-L -> Fem Pin 6
Original 40-Pin Nissan TCU Connector — Wire-Side View
(Plugs back into original TCU so hands-free microphone stays powered)
Nissan Leaf ZE1 40-Pin TCU Reference & Car-Side Pin Mapping:
• TCU #1 (W, White — +12V BAT) : Unpin OEM -> Fem #1 | Return wire: Fem #9 -> TCU #1
• TCU #28 (B, Black — GND) : Unpin OEM -> Fem #2 | Return wire: Fem #10 -> TCU #28
• TCU #6 (SB, Sky Blue — IT-CAN H): Unpin OEM -> Fem #3 | Leave TCU #6 EMPTY*
• TCU #7 (V, Violet — IT-CAN L) : Unpin OEM -> Fem #4 | Leave TCU #7 EMPTY*
• TCU #26 (SB, Sky Blue — M CAN-H) : [Optional AV-CAN] Unpin OEM -> Fem #5 | Leave #26 EMPTY*
• TCU #27 (LG, Lt Green — M CAN-L) : [Optional AV-CAN] Unpin OEM -> Fem #6 | Leave #27 EMPTY*
*Note: Two Sky Blue (SB) wires exist (#6 top row vs #26 bottom row)—tag them before unpinning!
NH .025" female pins from the 16-pin kit fit directly into the 40-pin TCU connector.
